  wave-shape response, but not proof of it. The inherited guidance already

Preserve the complete captured LOS/range/closing/half-cycle scaffold. Add one
new actuator mechanism only: continuously compress the fixed posterior phase
lag by a bounded fraction when the normalized terminal course redirect is
active. The gate is built from existing body-frame distance, course, and
velocity observations; using redirect magnitude makes the translation
reflection-equivariant and leaves the far-field propulsive wave unchanged.
The hypothesis is that a slightly more prompt posterior response during the
late course correction will reduce delayed hook/overshoot without removing the
posterior traveling wave or increasing static curvature authority.
